description: Returns the relative position of an item in a range that matches the specified value in the specified order.

params.description: The value to be matched in the range. It can be a number, text, or logical value, or a reference to one of these.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A contiguous range of cells or an array containing possible lookup values.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A number 1, 0, or -1 indicating which value to return.
